From the dark times of funding shortages and R&D obstacles to the triumph of successful tape-out and the steady progress of mass production, this startup's breakthrough journey vividly illustrates the domestic chip industry's determination to "face challenges head-on despite the risks."  

Answering the Call in Crisis: Embarking with the Conviction of "Putting National Interests Above All"  
On October 7, 2022, the U.S. Department of Commerce's 139-page export control order struck the Chinese semiconductor industry like a thunderbolt. The clause "comprehensive restrictions on high-performance chip design tools and manufacturing processes" pushed domestic chips into a dire situation where "without autonomy, there is no way out." Li Ying, who was leading AI chip R&D at Suiyuan Technology at the time, stayed awake all night. Years later, she recalled that it was the belief encapsulated in the phrase "Putting national interests above all, regardless of personal weal or woe" that solidified her resolve to dedicate herself to overcoming challenges in domestic chip development.  

"The lessons from the sanctions on ZTE and Huawei taught us that core technology cannot be bought or begged for," Li Ying noted. Her career has closely paralleled the history of China's chip industry breakthroughs. From being among the first employees at AMD's Beijing R&D center to serving as a key technical lead at Suiyuan Technology, she has contributed to the mass production of world-leading GPUs and witnessed firsthand the layered advancements in domestic chip processes and ecosystems.

Desde momentos críticos con fondos al límite y obstáculos en I+D, hasta la alegría del éxito en la fabricación y los pasos firmes hacia la producción en masa, la trayectoria de esta startup es un vivo ejemplo de la industria de chips nacional que, "sabiendo que hay tigres en la montaña, decide escalarla de todos modos". Asumiendo el cargo en tiempos difíciles: comenzar con la convicción de "si beneficia al país, daría incluso la vida".

Today, SenseTime's RiRiXin achieved a major breakthrough in spatial intelligence by officially releasing and open-sourcing the SenseNova-SI series models. In multiple authoritative evaluations of spatial understanding and reasoning tasks, SenseNova-SI not only significantly outperformed open-source multimodal large models of similar scale but also surpassed the performance of top international closed-source models like GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro.

Spatial Intelligence Shortcomings and Systemic Solutions

Currently, leading large models in the industry demonstrate outstanding performance in areas such as knowledge, writing, reasoning, and programming, but they commonly suffer from a critical weakness: a severe deficiency in understanding and reasoning about spatial structures. This is precisely the key foundational capability required for embodied agents to interact with the world.

Consider an example: the left image, derived from a graphical reasoning puzzle on "The Brain," poses considerable difficulty even for humans, yet GPT-5 solves it effortlessly, highlighting its strong capabilities in non-spatial intelligence. In contrast, the right image presents a simple spatial problem that even human children can easily solve, requiring the selection of the correct top-down view, but GPT-5 surprisingly struggles and incorrectly chooses "A."

This example precisely exposes the current shortcomings of large models in spatial understanding. Therefore, for AI to truly "see" the three-dimensional world, spatial intelligence has always been a crucial benchmark.

En múltiples evaluaciones autorizadas de comprensión y razonamiento espacial, SenseNova-SI no solo superó significativamente a modelos de gran multimodalidad de código abierto de escala similar, sino que también superó el rendimiento de modelos cerrados líderes internacionales como GPT-5 y Gemini 2.5 Pro.
